instruction: You are given a cavity template `/home/user/Desktop/cavity_base/`. Complete field-data sampling from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/cavity_graph/`: - Build square-cavity geometry and configure lid-driven flow - Run to convergence 2. Write sampling configuration to extract velocity along the geometric centerline. 3. Execute sampling and parse the sampled data. 4. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Vertical centerline `Ux` as `ux_center` - Horizontal centerline `Uy` as `uy_center` - Format: `ux_center, uy_center` 5. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
